scope: iOS or watchOS Simulator XCTest runner launch before the first product action
signatures: Failed to launch app with identifier: .*xctrunner
Application launch for .* did not return a process handle
Failed to initialize for UI testing
issues.rationale: The former one-reboot compatibility retry was removed after 50 consecutive dedicated iOS Simulator XCTest-process relaunches reached the App-owned functional empty state without this classification.
issues.exit_criteria: Remove the retry after 50 consecutive dedicated Apple Simulator launches without this classification, or replace it with an upstream-fixed Xcode/runtime version contract.

scope: Explicit QUALITY_PRECONDITION failures before product evidence begins
issues.rationale: This is a permanent attribution boundary, not a waiver: session, Simulator, fixture, permission, or readiness preparation must stop before product actions and cannot become product green.
issues.exit_criteria: Keep the category while App-owned preparation exists; fix each concrete precondition failure at its source and never retry it as a product assertion.
